اقتعدتا (form VIII)
# اِقْتَعَدَتَا (iqtaʕadatā) /iq.ta.ʕa.da.taː/: third-person feminine dual past active of اِقْتَعَدَ (iqtaʕada)
# اُقْتُعِدَتَا (uqtuʕidatā) /uq.tu.ʕi.da.taː/: third-person feminine dual past passive of اِقْتَعَدَ (iqtaʕada)
